```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", echo = FALSE)
library(regdatasets)
reg_path <- system.file("extdata", "registry.csv", package = "regdatasets")
reg <- utils::read.csv(reg_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")
```

This overview is generated from the package registry, the same table that
drives `list_datasets()` and the help pages.

## All datasets

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  reg[, c("dataset", "title", "unit", "n_rows", "n_cols")],
  col.names = c("Dataset", "Title", "One row is", "Rows", "Columns"),
  format.args = list(big.mark = ",")
)
```

## Datasets by topic

```{r}
topics <- c(
  "simple-regression", "ancova", "anova", "continuous-predictors",
  "interactions", "nonlinear", "model-building", "diagnostics",
  "logistic", "glm-latent", "ordinal", "multilevel-longitudinal"
)
by_topic <- vapply(topics, function(t) {
  parts <- strsplit(reg$topics, ";", fixed = TRUE)
  hit <- reg$dataset[vapply(parts, function(x) t %in% x, logical(1))]
  paste0("`", hit, "`", collapse = ", ")
}, character(1))
knitr::kable(data.frame(Topic = topics, Datasets = by_topic), row.names = FALSE)
```

## Sources

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  reg[, c("dataset", "source_citation", "provenance_status")],
  col.names = c("Dataset", "Source", "Provenance")
)
```

"Verified" means a checkable source ties the dataset to its origin; "probable"
means a strong match without an explicit statement. See `LICENSE.note` for the
redistribution basis of each dataset.

## Changed in version 1.0.0

In addition to stripping legacy Stata attributes across all datasets and
removing `lambert` and `civic_ed` (no redistribution basis), six shipped
datasets changed values or columns in version 1.0.0:

```{r}
summaries <- c(
  classdata_07 = "Replaced with a seeded simulated look-alike (no consent record for the 2007 survey).",
  disc         = "144 remaining nonresponse codes recoded to NA; race gained 'American Indian' (68 students).",
  disc2        = "race gained 'American Indian' (68 students).",
  gcse         = "Removed the stored model-prediction column pred (6 -> 5 columns).",
  nels_data    = "41,966 nonresponse, composite missing, and ordered 'don't know' codes recoded to NA.",
  titanic      = "Corrected embarked from titanic3 (355 passengers: 353 changed, 2 to NA)."
)
ch <- reg[!is.na(reg$values_changed_in), c("dataset", "values_changed_in")]
ch$summary <- unname(summaries[ch$dataset])
knitr::kable(
  ch,
  col.names = c("Dataset", "Version", "Summary of value/column changes"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

See `NEWS.md` for the full migration table.
